data.composeContent:
# Synthetic demo stack protected by the spike: http service + postgres + named volume + bind-mounted uploads/
# + sqlite file in a volume. Names are prefixed forklab-demo / forklab_ so lab.sh never touches foreign resources.
name: forklab-demo
services:
  db:
    image: postgres:17-alpine@sha256:266d3c257594e195b309ae9d1805e54c788f1d7b375f56bf6c367aac6c917e7b
    env_file: stack.env
    volumes: [pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data]
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U $${POSTGRES_USER} -d $${POSTGRES_DB}"]
      interval: 3s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 20
    networks:
      internal:
        # unique alias: an agent attached to BOTH the lab net and this net would otherwise resolve `db` to either Postgres
        aliases: [demo-db]

  web:
    # http service that reads DB rows + the uploads dir and serves them (busybox nc; no build, no extra image)
    image: postgres:17-alpine@sha256:266d3c257594e195b309ae9d1805e54c788f1d7b375f56bf6c367aac6c917e7b
    env_file: stack.env
    depends_on:
      db: {condition: service_healthy}
    entrypoint: ["/bin/sh", "/app/serve.sh"]
    volumes:
      - ./web/serve.sh:/app/serve.sh:ro
      - ./web/handle.sh:/app/handle.sh:ro
      - ./uploads:/uploads:ro
      - appdata:/appdata
    ports: ["192.0.2.1:18080:8080"]
    networks: [internal, lab_proxy]

  sqlite-writer:
    # keeps writing to a WAL-mode sqlite file inside a volume (D29 consistency probe); started by the drills, not by default
    image: ghcr.io/portabase/agent:1.25.2@sha256:e8f2b52eb4e59ed652d63d853a6bf517c31e9d41e3556115a2534ecbdde9df9f
    profiles: [sqlite]
    entrypoint: ["/bin/sh", "/app/sqlite-writer.sh"]
    volumes:
      - ./web/sqlite-writer.sh:/app/sqlite-writer.sh:ro
      - sqlitedata:/data
    networks: [internal]

  failing-webhook:
    # optional: calls a blackhole address (RFC 5737 doc range) forever and fails; never reaches a real host
    image: busybox:latest@sha256:a46257e06c82ad85242d0d38077d0a52d9896389ca60a1a59d3463db586e5fa4
    profiles: [failing-webhook]
    command: ["sh", "-c", "while true; do wget -q -T 2 -O /dev/null http://192.0.2.1/hook || echo webhook-failed; sleep 5; done"]
    networks: [internal]

volumes:
  pgdata:
  appdata:
  sqlitedata:

networks:
  internal:
    internal: true
  lab_proxy:
    name: lab_proxy
    external: true
data.name: forklab-demo

# Override file (part of the compose-dir `files` source): labels and restart policy only.
services:
  web:
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      forklab.role: app
  db:
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      forklab.role: database
